title: Last-Mile Delivery Optimization & Geospatial Intelligence
thesis: Snowflake combines AWS Location Service data with H3 geospatial functions and ML.FORECAST to optimize delivery operations across the Philippine archipelago — predicting volumes, identifying dead zones, and reducing failed deliveries

talking_points: 3.2 million parcels delivered monthly through 85 hubs and 12,000 riders.
Overall success rate: 91.3% — but 14 zones running below 85% (islands and remote Mindanao).
Average cost per delivery: ₱87 in NCR, ₱142 in Visayas, ₱198 in Mindanao.
show: Highlight 14 red zones on H3 map
tabs.call_out: 14 zones below 85% success — geographic challenges demand geospatial intelligence

transition.line: Let's drill into where deliveries fail and how to optimize.

talking_points: H3 hexagonal indexing: Philippines divided into 4,200 delivery zones at resolution 6.
Heatmap shows: failed deliveries cluster in areas with incomplete addressing (no house numbers).
ST_WITHIN analysis: 23% of failed deliveries are within 500m of a successful one — addressing issue, not access.
show: Show H3 hexagonal map with delivery density
tabs.call_out: 23% of failures are addressing issues — solvable with better geocoding

transition.line: The data tells us where to invest. Let's look at demand forecasting.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST predicts: 11.11 sale will spike volumes 340% — 3 hubs will exceed capacity.
Cebu hub: 18,000 parcels/day predicted vs 15,000 capacity — need overflow planning.
Rain season impact: Visayas zones see 12% delivery failure increase during typhoon months.
show: Display hub capacity vs forecast chart
tabs.call_out: 11.11 sale: 3 hubs will exceed capacity — plan overflow NOW

transition.line: Let the VP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Ricardo asks: 'Where should we open the next micro-hub?'
Cortex Analyst analyzes: H3 zone with highest volume + longest avg delivery time = Quezon City North.
Follow-up: 'What are riders reporting about failures in that zone?' — searches 4.1M delivery notes.
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL + geospatial analytics + delivery notes search

talking_points: Location Service → Snowpipe Streaming → H3 aggregation → ML.FORECAST → zone optimization.
H3 geospatial functions replace Location Service analytics — hexagonal indexing in SQL.
Philippines: 7,641 islands, 180M people. This platform covers 4,200 delivery zones nationwide.
tabs.call_out: Geospatial + ML forecasting — optimize deliveries across 7,641 islands

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Philippine logistics.
